text.card: A star 83% of the Sun's width that turns once in 9.43 days, with a mapped magnetic field.
text.introduction: Folsom et al. give it 0.83 solar radii, 0.9 solar masses, a rotation period of 9.43 days and an axis tilted 67° from the line of sight.
